### Gravity Zone { #awakening-gravity-zone }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/kilo/gravity_zone.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

### Infinity Kilo Punch { #awakening-infinity-kilo-punch }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/kilo/infinity_kilo_punch.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Punches with infinite weight, dealing massive damage and launching the target really far away. The target gets heavy in the air and slams back down after it reaches the top.

<!-- move awakenawakennomi:weight_shift -->

### Weight Shift { #awakening-weight-shift }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/kilo/weight_shift.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

In the air the user is really light, hits do a lot less damage but send them flying and they take no fall damage. Crouching on the ground makes the user weigh 10000 kilos so they cannot be knocked back or launched.
